plain_summary: Decisions stay stable under small input changes; some business-logic expectations are violated.
recommendation: Add input validation and imputation, apply monotonic constraints where the business logic requires them, and add a manual-review band around the decision threshold.
summary: Decision flip rate 1.3% at 1% noise, 4.0% at 5%, 5.7% at 10% of each feature's std (limit 5%). 10% missing numeric values flip 2.9% of decisions. monthly_income should be increasing: violated for 14.4% of rows. bureau_score should be increasing: violated for 7.8% of rows. debt_to_income should be decreasing: violated for 18.0% of rows.
title: Robustness to perturbation
